def test_select_cheapest_with_dimensional_weight_and_alphabetical_tie():
    from shipping import select
    # 16 billable kg: Economy 18.0, Express 13.0, Swift 13.0 -> tie goes to Express
    assert select(load()[0]) == {"id": "P1", "status": "selected", "service": "Express",
                                 "days": 2, "cost": 13.0}
    assert select(load()[1])["service"] == "Economy"


def test_select_unavailable_keeps_parcel_and_order():
    from shipping import select_batch
    result = select_batch(load())["parcels"]
    assert [r["id"] for r in result] == ["P1", "P2", "P3"]
    assert result[2]["status"] == "unavailable" and result[2]["reason"]
